verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests an optional tipping feature on the mint page.
The freelancer specifically claims implementation of preset and custom tip options.
The short client reply unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding concrete tipping design.
The client reports a concrete mint test in which the selected $1 tip did not work.
A new post-deployment test again shows failed tipping and an unexpected follow-up transaction.
The client clearly accepts Option A with explicit separate-transaction buttons and no automatic prompts.
The freelancer's test instruction indicates that the accepted success-modal behavior was deployed for validation.

execution.observed_behavior: Client reports that, despite the expected no-auto-prompt flow, a separate $1 tip transaction appeared immediately after minting; the mint-success modal was not seen and may have been hidden behind that transaction.

verdicts.decision_note: The failure is supported, but the causal claim about the modal should preserve the client's uncertainty.
The client explicitly confirms that the tested tip transaction worked.
The client requires UI wording that distinguishes the immediate tip transaction from another NFT purchase.
The freelancer claims deployment of a safeguard that disables self-tipping.
The client confirms actual receipt of the $3 tip from the freelancer's test mint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
okay, i just minted with 'no referral code' and a '$1 tip'.

I had to execute 1 transaction to mint - 0xc92e17e9e7f26e6b4e03093ce35f6ed3d7fc135c8ee00bc77357eb082779f715

And then another transaction immediately appeared for the tip - 0x887c21856bddc283cd444881931a1d14469cbbd49c2c2764e15855a9181af3b0

(We will have to put a UI note so that buyers know the tip transaction will come immediately after the mint transaction.)

Also, Perhaps it was hidden behind the tip transaction, but i didn't see the 'mint successful' modal.

And, on the leaderboard, there was no new commission and ticket counted.

value_updates.tip_transaction_notice: Tell buyers that the selected tip transaction comes immediately after the mint transaction.

missing_event_candidates.decision_note: The client first establishes the requirement for a tip-transaction UI notice in this message.
